player_prompt.intro:
O wena Player {player_id} mo Chopsticks. Ka nako ya gago, itlhophela sengwe sa:
  + Tlhase:  '[attack M O]'  kwa M=seatla sa gago (0 kgwedi 1), O=seatla sa mmaba (0 kgwedi 1).
    - Palo ya seatla sa mmaba e oketsega ka seatla sa gago; fa e >=5, e nna 0.
  + Arola:   '[split L R]'  go tsamaisa menwana ya gago yotlhe kwa L le R (L+R = yotlhe ya gago).
Araba ka sengwe fela sa ditlhogo tse.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Seatla sa moganetsi {opp_idx} se setse se sule.
invalid_move.split_sum: Palo ya dipalo tse di kgaoganngwang e tshwanetse go nna {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Go kgaoganya go tshwanetse ga fetola tsela e o dirisang diatla tsa gago ka yone.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Tlhogo e seng molaong. Tsaya “[attack M O]” kgwedi “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} e tlhabanya letsogo la P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: le tsamaya go tswa {opp_val} go ya {new_val}.

outcome.win: Diatla tsa moatlhodi di a swa.
outcome.draw: Tekanyetso ya go retologa e fitlhetswe.
